nodes.title: SG-8.3.3 Rewrite the repo-root context.md to the real stack and modules
nodes.body:
Context: context.md still describes a README-only repo with 13 UNKNOWN placeholders, while the repo holds game/src, game/frontend/src, game/docs/GDD.md and a Go backend. Desired behavior: context.md names TypeScript, Phaser 3.90, React, Zustand, Radix and Vitest, marks the Go backend out of scope, and has a module table with only existing paths. Expected result: the 7 failing tests in game/frontend/tests/contextDoc.test.ts and contextPaths.test.ts pass. Why: the docs must match the code.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the repo-root context.md, when missingTerms(text, STACK_TERMS) runs, then it returns [].
- Given the repo-root context.md, when staleTextHits runs, then it returns [] and the text has no UNKNOWN placeholder, 'hello Worldseed', 'README.md only' or 'No src/'.
- Given the module table, when contextModulePaths runs, then it includes game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/, and every path exists on disk.
- Given context.md, then the text names Go for the backend and marks it out of scope.


## Scope
- In scope: Repo-root context.md Purpose, Stack, Modules, Entry points, Workflows, Scan meta and Residual unknowns text
- In scope: Contract notes on the docs helpers
- Out of scope: backend/ Go code and the contribution/round API
- Out of scope: New features, content or art
- Out of scope: Phaser 4 migration
- Preserve: Phaser pinned at ~3.90.0 and the phaser-pin guard test
- Preserve: Gameplay of the boys-room world
- Preserve: No source file over 200 lines
- Preserve: game/src never imports from game/frontend
- Preserve: Existing tests are not deleted or skipped


## Technical constraints
- Hard: Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0, no Phaser 4 migration.
- Hard: backend/ (Go) and the contribution/round API are out of scope.
- Hard: npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/.
- Hard: tests mock only what is external.


## Definition of done
- The 7 context.md unit tests pass
- npm test and npm run typecheck are green in game/frontend/


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · context.md module table lists the real game and backend paths
nodes.body:
Context: contextModulePaths in game/frontend/src/lib/contextDoc.ts returns backticked game/ and backend/ paths from table rows. Desired behavior: the context.md Modules table has rows for game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/ (Go, out of scope), each existing on disk. Expected result: the module-paths suite passes. Why: readers find the real code and the GDD.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given context.md, when contextModulePaths runs, then the result contains game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/.
- Given those paths, when missingPaths checks them against the repo root with existsSync, then it returns [].
- Given context.md, then game/docs/GDD.md is referenced in the module table.


## Scope
- In scope: context.md Modules table and contextModulePaths contract note
- Out of scope: GDD content changes
- Preserve: contextModulePaths trailing-slash behaviour


## Technical constraints
- Hard: backend/ out of scope.
- Hard: no source file over 200 lines.


## Definition of done
- Module paths tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None
